_doc: FACS expression data. au_map: FACS Action Unit -> ARKit base blendshapes (never the TalkingHead composites mouthSmile/mouthOpen/eyesClosed, to avoid double-driving), following the ARKit<->FACS convention and calibrated per-model (e.g. AU25 parts the lips with mouthUpperUp+mouthLowerDown instead of jawOpen). expressions: name -> AU recipe. Recipe AU weights are the FINAL levels (one fixed intensity per expression): final morph = recipeWeight * au_map weight, clamped 0..1. Unilateral AU via _L/_R suffix (e.g. AU12_L). kind 'mood' (default) holds until replaced; kind 'beat' plays once with its envelope {in, hold, out} ms. Moods never use jawOpen (AU26), which fights the lip-sync visemes; AU25 stands in where a canonical combination has AU26. The 7 core recipes use the canonical EMFACS-7 AU combinations; the rest are documented blends of the same primitives. au_limits (per avatar, from visual review): AU -> {max, beatMax?, note}, the highest level that still reads natural on this avatar in a held mood (beatMax for beats, default max). avoid: [{aus: {AU: level, ...}, note}], combinations that read wrong together: no recipe may exceed every listed level at once. Levels count a unilateral AU on its side (AU12 + AU12_L). test/facs.test.js enforces both; nothing is clamped at runtime.

_sources.emfacs: Emotional FACS (Ekman & Friesen 1983) — canonical AU combinations for the basic emotions. https://www.paulekman.com/facial-action-coding-system/
_sources.au_to_arkit: ARKit<->FACS mapping convention (each ARKit blendshape ~ one FACS AU). https://melindaozel.com/arkit-to-facs-cheat-sheet/ ; clinical blendshape<->AU mapping https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2451958826001995 ; interactive ARKit-52<->AU guide https://arkit.miniface.org/faces
_sources.stylized_3d: AU-Blendshape: Fine-grained Stylized 3D Facial Expression Manipulation (arXiv:2507.12001) — approach for driving stylized (cartoon) 3D faces via Action Units, and the need for per-model AU calibration.

happy.description: Warm, genuine smile: glad, pleased, friendly, good news.
happy.facs: EMFACS-7 happiness: AU6+AU12, with AU7 and lips part (AU25) for an open smile

sad.description: Sadness: sorrow, grief, bad news, missing someone.

surprise.facs: EMFACS-7 surprise: AU1+AU2+AU5+AU26, with AU25 in place of AU26

fear.description: Fear: scared, alarmed, anxious about a threat.
fear.facs: EMFACS-7 fear: AU1+AU2+AU4+AU5+AU7+AU20+AU26, with AU25 in place of AU26

contempt.description: Contempt or smugness: one-sided smirk, superiority, sarcasm.

laugh.description: A brief laugh: something genuinely funny, a joke landing.
laugh.facs: extension: intensified happiness (AU6+AU7+AU12) + lips part (AU25) + slight jaw drop (AU26)

excited.description: Excitement: thrilled, can't wait, high-energy enthusiasm.
excited.facs: extension: open happiness (AU6+AU12+AU25) + surprise brows and eyes (AU1+AU2+AU5)

amused.description: Amused: playful, teasing, light-hearted, mildly funny.
amused.facs: extension: lopsided happiness (AU6+AU7, AU12 stronger on the left) + left dimpler (AU14_L) + lips part (AU25)

wistful.facs: extension: sadness brows (AU1+AU4) x faint happiness (AU6+AU12)

tender.description: Tender warmth: caring, comforting, compassionate, gentle support.
tender.facs: extension: soft closed smile (AU6+AU12) + raised inner brows (AU1)

love.facs: extension: happiness (AU6+AU7+AU12) + inner-brow warmth (AU1) + lips softly parted (AU25)

proud.description: Pride: accomplishment, confidence, praising someone's achievement.

relieved.facs: extension: gentle happiness (AU6+AU12) + inner-brow lift (AU1) + lips part (AU25)

shy.description: Shy: bashful, embarrassed, flattered by a compliment.
shy.facs: extension: lopsided soft smile (AU6+AU12+AU14) + inner brow (AU1) + gaze down (AU64)

curious.description: Curiosity: interested, intrigued, wanting to know more.
curious.facs: extension: brow raise (AU1+AU2, left higher) + AU5 + lips part (AU25)

skeptical.facs: extension: asymmetric brow (AU2_L raise + AU4_R lower) + AU7 + one-sided dimpler (AU14_R)

confused.facs: extension: knit brows (AU1+AU4) + one raised outer brow (AU2_R) + AU15 + lips part (AU25)

pensive.description: Thoughtful: considering, reflecting, weighing an answer.
pensive.facs: extension: mild brow lower + lid tighten (AU1+AU4+AU7) + pressed, raised chin (AU17+AU23) + AU14_R

nervous.facs: extension: worried brows (AU1+AU4) + lip stretch/press (AU20+AU23) + AU7 + faint smile (AU12)

disappointed.description: Disappointment: let down, mild regret, 'that's a shame'.

sleepy.description: Sleepy or tired: drowsy, exhausted, bedtime.

pleading.facs: extension: strong inner brow raise (AU1+AU2) + AU5 + slight frown (AU15) + lips part (AU25)

wink.description: A playful wink: a shared secret, a joke, flirting.
wink.facs: AU46 wink (unilateral AU43) + same-side cheek raise and smile (AU6_L+AU12_L)

tongue_out.description: Tongue out: cheeky teasing, silly playfulness.
tongue_out.facs: AU19 tongue show + lips part (AU25) + slight jaw drop (AU26)

raise_eyebrows.description: A quick eyebrow flash: emphasis, greeting, 'oh!', interest.

eyeroll.description: An eye roll: exasperation, mock annoyance, 'whatever'.

yawn.facs: AU1+AU25+AU26+AU43 (brows up, jaw wide open, eyes shut)

side_glance.description: A sideways glance: suspicion, conspiratorial teasing.
